delimiterFact: trailing literal edge of the left operand or leading literal edge of the right operand
insideTokenWhen: a visible literal edge is non-whitespace
tokenBoundaryWhen: a visible literal edge is DOM ASCII whitespace
unknownWhen: neither operand exposes a literal edge

insideTokenWhen: a non-empty adjacent quasi edge contains no boundary whitespace
tokenBoundaryWhen: an adjacent quasi edge is DOM ASCII whitespace
unknownWhen: all adjacent quasis are empty and the interpolations expose no boundary

delimiterFact: the construct inserts U+0020 between contributing arguments
tokenBoundaryWhen: the implicit U+0020 separator is present
unknownWhen: the call is not a recognized class-list constructor

delimiterFact: the exact separator argument, with the JavaScript comma default when omitted
insideTokenWhen: the exact separator contains no DOM ASCII whitespace
tokenBoundaryWhen: the exact separator contains DOM ASCII whitespace

delimiterFact: the owning clsx/classnames call's implicit U+0020 separator
tokenBoundaryWhen: the entry is selected by its guard
unknownWhen: the owning call is not recognized or the property key is dynamic

delimiterFact: no literal or exact separator is visible
unknownWhen: both operands are opaque to the source and type-fact planes
